snippet.title: Valehands Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The Demo of Valehands is out! 
You can play it for free on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4169900/Valehands

Valehands is a cozy incremental management sim about guiding dwarven crews through their daily work and bringing their valley to life.
